findings.finding: Results-based thinking is emphasized over traditional price-based thinking in overcoming objections about expense in real estate deals.
findings.qualification: This perspective is self-reported and observed in nature, underlying sales strategy guidance.

findings.finding: A private coaching program claimed to offer a return of 4,054% on investment, underscored by closing six deals in one week.
findings.qualification: The claim is self-reported with no external validation, representing significant impact metrics from individual client experiences.

findings.finding: The earnings of 270,000 AED were directly pocketed by the individual after closing six deals in one week.
findings.qualification: Self-reported financial result without external corroboration; individual testimonies highlight personal financial success.

findings.finding: Encouraging agents and sales professionals to share their most challenging objections offers insight into common sales resistance areas.
findings.qualification: A participatory post aimed at gathering qualitative sentiment from the sales community.

findings.finding: Training frequency in sales is questioned, suggesting potential inadequacies in professional development within companies.
findings.qualification: The post posits a reflection on training practices, self-reported as part of observational data.

findings.finding: Landlords pressuring agents to list properties at unrealistic prices is a common issue in the real estate industry.
findings.qualification: This claim is self-reported with potential industry-wide implications, highlighting negotiation challenges.

findings.finding: The use of psychological tactics to modify client perceptions is considered vital for overcoming objections in the real estate market.
findings.qualification: Suggestive advisories are offered without empirical studies; self-reported effectiveness in agent strategies.

findings.finding: Offering specialized training for selling real estate off-plan via Zoom addresses emerging digital sales methodologies.
findings.qualification: This is positioned as a necessity by the author, indicative of adaptation to virtual sales environments.
